title: Courage & Strength
intro: The teenage version of courage is rarely dramatic. It is telling the truth when a lie is easier, leaving a room you should not be in, and being the only one who does not laugh. This month we name that as strength, and we say the other thing too — that being tired, anxious or in need of help is not the opposite of being strong.

keyScriptures.text: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.
My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.

weeks.title: Courage Is Not a Feeling
weeks.declaration: Courage is not the absence of fear; it is the decision you make while the fear is still there. Waiting to feel brave before you act is waiting for something that does not come.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, teach our child to act on conviction rather than on how they feel. Steady their hands while their heart is still racing. Amen.

weeks.title: The Bravest Things Are Quiet
weeks.declaration: Leaving the room. Telling the truth when a lie is easier. Being the one who does not laugh. Nobody applauds these, and they are the ones that build you.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, make our child brave where nobody is watching. Let their private courage shape their public life. Amen.

weeks.title: Strong Is Not the Same as Fine
weeks.declaration: You are allowed to be struggling and strong at the same time. Needing help is not the opposite of courage; refusing it is what actually costs you.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, take the shame out of our child's struggle. Make them the kind of person who asks. Amen.

weeks.title: Strength You Did Not Manufacture
weeks.declaration: You are not asked to generate your own strength. It is given, daily, for exactly what today holds and no further.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, give our child what today needs. Teach them to come back tomorrow rather than to stockpile. Amen.

days.title: Not a Feeling
days.declaration: Courage is not the absence of fear. It is the decision you make while the fear is still there.

scripture.text: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged.

days.title: The Quiet Kind
days.declaration: The bravest things you will do this year are quiet: leaving, refusing, telling the truth. Nobody will clap.

scripture.text: Act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with your God.

days.title: Strong and Struggling
days.declaration: You can be struggling and strong at the same time. Those are not opposites, whatever anyone implies.

scripture.text: My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.

days.title: Asking Is Strength
days.declaration: Refusing help is not toughness; it is just expensive. Asking is what strong people actually do.

scripture.text: Two are better than one... if either of them falls down, one can help the other up.

days.title: Leaving the Room
days.declaration: Walking out of a situation you should not be in is one of the most underrated forms of courage.

scripture.text: Do not be misled: bad company corrupts good character.

days.title: The One Who Does Not Laugh
days.declaration: Being the only one who does not join in is genuinely hard. It also gives permission to everyone else who wanted to stop.

scripture.text: Do not conform to the pattern of this world.

days.title: Fear Does Not Command You
days.declaration: You will feel afraid. You are not obliged to obey it. Fear can be present without being in charge.

scripture.text: The Spirit God gave us does not make us timid, but gives us power, love and self-discipline.

days.title: Owning It
days.declaration: Admitting what you did, without excuses, takes more nerve than defending it. It is also the fastest way out.

scripture.text: Whoever conceals their sins does not prosper, but the one who confesses and renounces them finds mercy.

days.title: Strength for Today Only
days.declaration: You are not given strength for the whole year in advance. You are given today's, which is why you have to come back.

scripture.text: His mercies are new every morning.

days.title: Anxiety Is Not a Character Flaw
days.declaration: Being anxious does not mean you lack faith or courage. It means you are a person, and you can be helped.

scripture.text: Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer... present your requests to God.

days.title: Doing It Tired
days.declaration: Some days courage is just carrying on when you are exhausted. That is not less brave; it is more.

scripture.text: Let us not become weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap a harvest.

days.title: Standing Alone
days.declaration: Sometimes nobody stands with you. Doing the right thing alone is still worth it and it is still seen.

scripture.text: At my first defence, no one came to my support... But the Lord stood at my side.

days.title: You Have Done Hard Things
days.declaration: You have already survived things you thought you could not. Look back at them when today looks impossible.

scripture.text: The Lord who rescued me from the paw of the lion... will rescue me.

days.title: Not the Loudest
days.declaration: Strength does not need an audience. The people who talk most about being tough are usually not.

scripture.text: In quietness and trust is your strength.

days.title: Facing What You Are Avoiding
days.declaration: The thing you are avoiding is costing you more than facing it would. Go at it a piece at a time.

scripture.text: I can do all this through him who gives me strength.

days.title: Brave With Your Body
days.declaration: Looking after your body when you do not feel like it — sleeping, eating, moving — is a quiet act of courage.

scripture.text: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit?

days.title: Speaking Up
days.declaration: Saying 'that is not okay' out loud, in the moment, is hard. It is also how things actually change.

scripture.text: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves.

days.title: Knowing When Not To
days.declaration: Restraint is courage too. Not every provocation deserves your response, and silence is sometimes the strong move.

scripture.text: Fools give full vent to their rage, but the wise bring calm in the end.

days.title: Starting Again
days.declaration: Starting again after you have failed publicly takes more courage than starting the first time. Do it anyway.

scripture.text: Though I have fallen, I will rise.

days.title: Not Numbing It
days.declaration: Numbing a hard feeling does not remove it, it postpones it with interest. Facing it is the braver and cheaper route.

scripture.text: Pour out your hearts to him, for God is our refuge.

days.title: Held While You Try
days.declaration: You are held while you are trying, not only when you succeed. That is precisely why you can risk it.

scripture.text: I am the Lord your God who takes hold of your right hand and says to you, Do not fear.

days.title: Courage to Be Known
days.declaration: Letting people see the real you is frightening and it is the only route to actually being known.

scripture.text: You have searched me, Lord, and you know me.

days.title: Not Rescued From, Walked Through
days.declaration: God does not usually take the hard thing away. He goes through it with you, which turns out to be better.

scripture.text: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you.

days.title: The Strength to Wait
days.declaration: Waiting well is a form of strength. Not everything worth having arrives at the speed you would like.

scripture.text: Those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength.

days.title: Gentle Is Not Weak
days.declaration: Staying gentle when you could be cutting is strength under control. That is the whole definition.

scripture.text: Clothe yourselves with compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness and patience.

days.title: Under Pressure
days.declaration: Who you are under pressure is who you are. Pressure does not build character so much as reveal it — and reveal what to work on.

scripture.text: The testing of your faith produces perseverance.

days.title: Everyone Looks Further Ahead
days.declaration: Everyone else looks further ahead than they are. You are not late, and panic is a poor navigator.

scripture.text: My times are in your hands.

days.title: Small and Consequential
days.declaration: You are not too young for what you are being asked to do. God has never been particular about that.

scripture.text: Do not let anyone look down on you because you are young, but set an example.

days.title: Strength That Is Given
days.declaration: You are not asked to manufacture strength. It is supplied, daily, for exactly what today holds.

scripture.text: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him.

days.title: Courage Compounds
days.declaration: Every brave thing you do makes the next one slightly easier. That is how this works.

scripture.text: They go from strength to strength.

days.title: Carry the Courage
days.declaration: Everything you have faced this month has made you stronger for what comes next. Carry it.

scripture.text: Be strong and courageous... for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.
